sessions.label: New feature, idea to PR
sessions.title: Saved searches for a recipe app
sessions.blurb: The everyday flow. One feature goes through every stop of the loop in a single session.

steps.note: Publish the spec as an issue

chat.you: `/grill-with-docs` Users should be able to save a search and get told when new recipes match it.

chat.ai: **Q1.** Is a saved search only the query text, or the text plus filters like “vegan” or “under 30 min”?
chat.rec: Recommended: text + filters, stored as one Saved Search.

chat.you: Text plus filters. Only dietary filters for now.

chat.ai: **Q2.** Where should someone find out about a new match: in the app, by email, or both?
chat.rec: Recommended: in-app badge first. Email adds scheduling and unsubscribe work.

chat.ai: **Q3.** If a dietary filter is renamed later, should old saved searches follow the rename?
chat.rec: Recommended: yes. Store filter IDs, not labels.

chat.ai: Published the spec **“Saved searches with in-app alerts”** as issue `#142`.
Four tracer-bullet tickets:
list: `#143` Save a search end to end (UI → API → DB)
`#144` Match new recipes against saved searches (blocked by #143)
`#145` In-app alert badge (blocked by #144)
`#146` Rename and delete saved searches (blocked by #143)

event.text: red: “saving a search keeps its filter IDs” fails → green → refactor
standards ✓ · spec: empty query was allowed, now rejected

chat.ai: #143 is done: 6 tests, all green. #144 and #146 are unblocked.
PR body drafted:
list: **Summary:** users can save a search with dietary filters
**Before/after:** screenshots of the search page
**Merge danger:** low. New table, no changes to existing data

sessions.label: A nasty bug
sessions.title: Checkout total is 1p off
sessions.blurb: Something is broken and nobody knows why. Diagnose it in phases instead of guessing.

chat.you: Some carts show a total that's 1p higher at checkout. Support has 3 tickets. Diagnose this.

chat.ai: **Phase 1, reproduce.** I wrote a script with the cart from ticket #311. It reproduces 1 out of 1 times: expected £2.84, got £2.85.
**Phase 2, minimise.** The smallest failing case: three items at £1.05 with a 10% discount.
**Phase 3, hypothesise.** Ranked:
list: The discount is rounded per line, not on the total
A float error in the sum
Currency conversion on display

chat.ai: **Phase 4, instrument.** I logged inside `applyDiscount`. Each line rounds 94.5p up to 95p, so 3 × 95 = 285 instead of round(283.5) = 284. **Hypothesis 1 is confirmed.**
**Phase 5, fix.** Work in integer pence and round once, on the discounted total.
Fixed. I removed the instrumentation and kept the regression test.
PR body drafted. **Root cause:** per-line rounding. **Merge danger:** medium. Totals change by up to 1p on some discounted carts, so let support know.

sessions.label: Multi-day project
sessions.title: Moving auth to tokens across 3 services
sessions.blurb: Too big for one session. Map the decisions first, hand off between days, then build in parallel.

steps.note: Resolve one decision at a time

chat.you: `/wayfinder` We want to move from server sessions to tokens in the web, mobile and admin services.

chat.ai: Here is a map of decisions to make before anyone writes code:
list: `D1` Token format and lifetime
`D2` Refresh strategy (blocked by D1)
`D3` Rollout order across the services
`D4` How existing sessions get logged out (blocked by D3)

chat.ai: D1 is resolved: short-lived access tokens with a 15-minute lifetime. Recorded as an ADR.

chat.you: I'm out of time for today. `/handoff`

event.file: HANDOFF.md  · map, D1 decided, D2–D4 open

chat.ai: Picking up from the map: D1 is done, D2 is unblocked. Here is the first D2 question…
Spec `#210` published, with 7 tickets. Three are ready now: web, admin, shared library.
Ready tickets are being built in parallel on one integration branch. Each one runs tdd and finishes with code-review. Mobile starts once the shared library lands.

sessions.label: Codebase upkeep
sessions.title: Friday survey and session retro
sessions.blurb: Every few days, look for modules worth deepening. After a session, fix what slowed you down.

chat.ai: Top 3 from the report:
list: Pricing logic is spread across 6 files with no single entry point
`NotificationService` exposes 14 methods, and callers use 3 of them
Date parsing is duplicated in the API and the worker
chat.after: Which one should we dig into?

chat.ai: **Q1.** What should callers have to know to get a price: only the cart, or the cart plus the user's plan?
chat.rec: Recommended: cart + plan. Discounts depend on the plan.

chat.ai: Resulting design: one deep `Pricing` module with a single `quote(cart, plan)` function, and the 6 files behind it. The term goes into GLOSSARY.md.
3 tickets created: extract with tests, move callers, delete the old paths.
Fixes for your environment, worst first:
list: **The test suite takes 4 min.** Add a fast unit-test command to CLAUDE.md so the agent runs that one while it iterates.
**The agent mixed up “Plan” and “Subscription”.** Add both to GLOSSARY.md.
**Lint ran only in CI.** Add a pre-commit hook.
